description: This file defines an interface 'IFaultableConsumerGrain' within the namespace 'UnitTests.GrainInterfaces'. The interface extends 'IGrainWithGuidKey' and declares several asynchronous methods related to stream consumption, failure handling, and status retrieval, indicating it's part of a testing framework for grain-based streaming applications.

classes.name: IFaultableConsumerGrain
classes.description: An interface for a faultable consumer grain used in test scenarios, providing methods to control and query its state.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Initializes the grain to become a consumer for a given stream identified by streamId and streamNamespace, with a specified provider.

methods.name: SetFailPeriod
methods.description: Sets the period during which the grain should simulate failures.

methods.name: StopConsuming
methods.description: Stops the grain from consuming further streams.

methods.name: GetNumberConsumed
methods.description: Returns the number of messages successfully consumed.

methods.name: GetNumberFailed
methods.description: Returns the number of failures occurred during consumption.

methods.name: GetErrorCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of errors encountered by the grain.
